raw.description: 每次在场首次攻击后触发灰鳞变，自身本场战斗灰鳞变的触发次数每有1次自身造成的攻击伤害提升10%，每有5次自身所有技能先制+1|自身首次受到致死伤害时，若本场战斗灰鳞变的触发次数不为0，则将其翻倍且本场战斗灰鳞变不再减少体力上限，然后自身解除所处的异常状态、体力上限增加灰鳞变所减少的体力上限并主动恢复差值的体力，之后当回合受到致死伤害时保留1点体力|（boss无效）
raw.analyze_desc: [sprite name=dot4]每次在场首次攻击后触发[color=#f35555]灰鳞变[/color]，自身本场战斗[color=#f35555]灰鳞变[/color]的触发次数每有1次自身造成的攻击伤害提升10%，每有5次自身所有[color=#52a5f2]技能先制[/color]+1|[sprite name=dot4]自身[color=#52a5f2]首次[/color]受到[color=#52a5f2]致死伤害[/color]时，若本场战斗[color=#f35555]灰鳞变[/color]的触发次数不为0，则将其翻倍且本场战斗[color=#f35555]灰鳞变[/color]不再减少体力上限，[color=#52a5f2]然后[/color]自身解除所处的异常状态、体力上限增加[color=#f35555]灰鳞变[/color]所减少的体力上限并主动恢复差值的体力，[color=#52a5f2]之后[/color][color=#52a5f2]当回合[/color]受到[color=#52a5f2]致死伤害[/color]时[color=#52a5f2]保留[/color]1点体力

review.reviewedBy: Codex primary API exact source and battle-state verification
review.rationale: 每次在场首次攻击的当前首次、当前计数增伤/先制、首次致死均当前实现；仅真实离场后再次登场重置首次标记依赖换宠。准备累计次数前态验证所有当前数值分支，不冒充实现换宠。
review.singleBehavior: 首次攻击无论MISS/无效触发灰鳞，命中按公共理论百分比吸取；实际上限减少独立于伤害，累计次数当前增伤/先制。首次致死在完整伤害结算后翻倍、净异、返还实际差并魂印回复，当前回合保1且完整正伤事件保留。

success.name: 4885全部17招逐实例有序编译、64种子基础与完整真实2071原生用招，魂印和技能ID分域，原魂印hash匹配
success.assertion: test('4885全部17招逐实例有序编译、64种子基础与完整真实2071原生用招，魂印和技能ID分域，原魂印hash匹配',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(c.issue,'');const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]),c.operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]));turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulId,2071);require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4885 base '+m.id);}});

success.name: 4885真实2071首次攻击后灰鳞减最大HP100并记录实际减少，命中则最大HP三分一百分比理论吸取，满HP裁剪不是伤害
success.assertion: test('4885真实2071首次攻击后灰鳞减最大HP100并记录实际减少，命中则最大HP三分一百分比理论吸取，满HP裁剪不是伤害',()=>{for(const mode of['normal','immune','overkill','floor','full','skill-ban']){const s=make({move:10086,soul:true,hp:mode==='full'?9000:1000,targetHp:mode==='overkill'?100:mode==='floor'?1:9000});if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');if(mode==='floor')timer(s,1,'致命保留',{hp:1});if(mode==='skill-ban')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');turn(s);const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.moth2071;assert.equal(st.count,1);assert.equal(st.lostMaxHp,100);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,8900);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='full'?8900:4000);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),mode==='immune'?0:3000);assert.equal(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.targetSide===0).length,0);if(mode==='floor'){const e=s.damageEvents.find(e=>e.type==='percent');assert.equal(e.settledDamage,3000);assert.equal(e.hpLoss,0);}if(s.fighters[1].hp>0)turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.moth2071.count,1);}});

success.name: 4885真实2071 MISS和整招无效仍首次灰鳞但不吸取，控制/药剂/属性不算攻击
success.assertion: test('4885真实2071 MISS和整招无效仍首次灰鳞但不吸取，控制/药剂/属性不算攻击',()=>{for(const mode of['miss','invalid','control','potion','status']){const s=make({move:mode==='status'?20231:10086,soul:true,hp:1000,hit:mode!=='miss'});if(mode==='miss')timer(s,0,'攻击必失');if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,0,'skillBlock');if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=2;turn(s,mode==='potion'?null:s.auditMoveId);const yes=mode==='miss'||mode==='invalid';assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.moth2071.count,yes?1:0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,yes?8900:9000);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),0);}});

success.name: 4885真实2071当前累计次数每次10%红增伤、每5次全技能优先1，首次灰鳞本次本体不提前增伤
success.assertion: test('4885真实2071当前累计次数每次10%红增伤、每5次全技能优先1，首次灰鳞本次本体不提前增伤',()=>{for(const count of[0,1,4,5,10]){const a=make({move:10086,soul:true}),b=make({move:10086});Object.assign(a.fighters[0].soulState.moth2071,{count,firstAttackHere:true});turn(a);turn(b);const ratio=1+count*.1;assert.ok(sum(a)>=Math.floor(sum(b)*ratio));assert.ok(sum(a)<Math.ceil((sum(b)+1)*ratio));assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,Math.floor(count/5));}const a=make({move:10086,soul:true}),b=make({move:10086});turn(a);turn(b);assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b));assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.moth2071.count,1);});

success.name: 4885真实2071首次致死翻倍次数、返还实际上限并魂印主动回复差值，先清中毒后保命；同回合1HP再受正伤仍完整记录而不再翻倍
success.assertion: test('4885真实2071首次致死翻倍次数、返还实际上限并魂印主动回复差值，先清中毒后保命；同回合1HP再受正伤仍完整记录而不再翻倍',()=>{const s=warm();s.fighters[0].hp=200;s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']=3;timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){c.hurt(c.t,800,'第一次完整固定800','fixed');assert.equal(c.t.hp,1);assert.equal(c.t.stats.maxHp,9000);assert.equal(c.t.ailments['中毒'],undefined);assert.equal(c.t.soulState.moth2071.count,2);c.hurt(c.t,100,'当回合第二次完整真实100','true');assert.equal(c.t.hp,1);assert.equal(c.t.soulState.moth2071.count,2);}},()=>turn(s));const hits=s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.round===2&&e.targetSide===0);assert.deepEqual(hits.map(e=>[e.settledDamage,e.hpLoss]),[[800,299],[100,0]]);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.moth2071.fatalEvents[0].healed,100);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.moth2071.noMoreMaxHpLoss,true);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.hurt(c.t,10,'下一回合致死','fixed');},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.moth2071.fatalEvents.length,1);});

success.name: 4885真实2071免疫零结算不消费首次致死，首次0灰鳞条件不满足也已属于本场首次，不因其他保命存活再重试
success.assertion: test('4885真实2071免疫零结算不消费首次致死，首次0灰鳞条件不满足也已属于本场首次，不因其他保命存活再重试',()=>{const s=warm();s.fighters[0].hp=200;timer(s,0,'固定百分比免疫');observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){c.hurt(c.t,800,'免疫归零','fixed');assert.equal(c.t.soulState.moth2071.firstLethalSeen,false);delete c.t.effects['固定百分比免疫'];c.hurt(c.t,800,'免疫后真实致死','fixed');assert.equal(c.t.soulState.moth2071.count,2);}},()=>turn(s));const z=make({move:10086,soul:true,hp:200,aStats:{spe:50}});timer(z,0,'致命保留',{hp:1},1,1);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.hurt(c.t,800,'零灰鳞首次致死','fixed');},()=>turn(z));assert.equal(z.fighters[0].soulState.moth2071.firstLethalSeen,true);assert.equal(z.fighters[0].soulState.moth2071.count,1);assert.equal(z.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,8900);z.fighters[0].hp=200;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.hurt(c.t,800,'后续不得重试首次','fixed');},()=>turn(z));assert.equal(z.fighters[0].hp,0);assert.equal(z.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,8900);});

boundary.name: 4885全部17招逐实例有序编译、64种子基础与完整真实2071原生用招，魂印和技能ID分域，原魂印hash匹配
boundary.assertion: test('4885全部17招逐实例有序编译、64种子基础与完整真实2071原生用招，魂印和技能ID分域，原魂印hash匹配',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(c.issue,'');const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]),c.operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]));turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulId,2071);require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4885 base '+m.id);}});

boundary.name: 4885真实2071首次攻击后灰鳞减最大HP100并记录实际减少，命中则最大HP三分一百分比理论吸取，满HP裁剪不是伤害
boundary.assertion: test('4885真实2071首次攻击后灰鳞减最大HP100并记录实际减少，命中则最大HP三分一百分比理论吸取，满HP裁剪不是伤害',()=>{for(const mode of['normal','immune','overkill','floor','full','skill-ban']){const s=make({move:10086,soul:true,hp:mode==='full'?9000:1000,targetHp:mode==='overkill'?100:mode==='floor'?1:9000});if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');if(mode==='floor')timer(s,1,'致命保留',{hp:1});if(mode==='skill-ban')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');turn(s);const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.moth2071;assert.equal(st.count,1);assert.equal(st.lostMaxHp,100);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,8900);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='full'?8900:4000);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),mode==='immune'?0:3000);assert.equal(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.targetSide===0).length,0);if(mode==='floor'){const e=s.damageEvents.find(e=>e.type==='percent');assert.equal(e.settledDamage,3000);assert.equal(e.hpLoss,0);}if(s.fighters[1].hp>0)turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.moth2071.count,1);}});

boundary.name: 4885真实2071 MISS和整招无效仍首次灰鳞但不吸取，控制/药剂/属性不算攻击
boundary.assertion: test('4885真实2071 MISS和整招无效仍首次灰鳞但不吸取，控制/药剂/属性不算攻击',()=>{for(const mode of['miss','invalid','control','potion','status']){const s=make({move:mode==='status'?20231:10086,soul:true,hp:1000,hit:mode!=='miss'});if(mode==='miss')timer(s,0,'攻击必失');if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,0,'skillBlock');if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=2;turn(s,mode==='potion'?null:s.auditMoveId);const yes=mode==='miss'||mode==='invalid';assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.moth2071.count,yes?1:0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,yes?8900:9000);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),0);}});

boundary.name: 4885真实2071当前累计次数每次10%红增伤、每5次全技能优先1，首次灰鳞本次本体不提前增伤
boundary.assertion: test('4885真实2071当前累计次数每次10%红增伤、每5次全技能优先1，首次灰鳞本次本体不提前增伤',()=>{for(const count of[0,1,4,5,10]){const a=make({move:10086,soul:true}),b=make({move:10086});Object.assign(a.fighters[0].soulState.moth2071,{count,firstAttackHere:true});turn(a);turn(b);const ratio=1+count*.1;assert.ok(sum(a)>=Math.floor(sum(b)*ratio));assert.ok(sum(a)<Math.ceil((sum(b)+1)*ratio));assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,Math.floor(count/5));}const a=make({move:10086,soul:true}),b=make({move:10086});turn(a);turn(b);assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b));assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.moth2071.count,1);});

boundary.name: 4885真实2071首次致死翻倍次数、返还实际上限并魂印主动回复差值，先清中毒后保命；同回合1HP再受正伤仍完整记录而不再翻倍

success.assertion: test('4885真实2071当前累计次数每次10%红增伤、每5次全技能优先1，首次灰鳞本次本体不提前增伤',()=>{for(const count of[0,1,4,5,10]){const a=make({move:10086,soul:true}),b=make({move:10086});Object.assign(a.fighters[0].soulState.moth2071,{count,firstAttackHere:true});turn(a);turn(b);const ratio=1+count*.1;assert.ok(sum(a)>=Math.floor(sum(b)*ratio));assert.ok(sum(a)<Math.ceil((sum(b)+1)*ratio));assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,Math.floor(count/5));}const a=make({move:10086,soul:true}),b=make({move:10086});turn(a);turn(b);assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b));assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.moth2071.count,1);});

success.name: 4885/5真实命中速度弱化，15与11害怕中毒有成功失败、免疫不补抽；645低于三分一才威力三倍及93原生10%追加固定100
success.assertion: test('4885/5真实命中速度弱化，15与11害怕中毒有成功失败、免疫不补抽；645低于三分一才威力三倍及93原生10%追加固定100',()=>{const slow=make({move:32116});turn(slow,32116,null);assert.equal(slow.fighters[1].stages.spe,-1);for(const [move,status]of[[20231,'害怕'],[32119,'中毒']]){const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=32;seed++){const s=make({move,seed:Math.imul(seed,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});turn(s);seen.add(!!s.fighters[1].ailments[status]);}if(move===32119)assert.equal(seen.size,2);else assert.deepEqual(seen,new Set([true]));}for(const [id,low,edge]of[[645,2999,3000]]){for(const hp of[low,edge]){const s=make({...row(id),hp}),m=source.moves.find(x=>x.id===s.auditMoveId),power=probePower(()=>turn(s));assert.equal(power,hp===low?m.power*3:m.power);}}});

success.assertion: test('4885/1508先出手无视攻击免疫而后手受免，1978清强成功害怕失败才自身最大HP三分一粉，失败与保护范围明确',()=>{for(const first of[false,true]){const s=make({...row(1508),aStats:{spe:first?500:50}});s.moveDefinitions[key(20117)].priority=3;timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(s);assert.equal(sum(s)>0,first);}for(const mode of['success','none','protected','immune']){const s=make(row(1978));if(mode!=='none')s.fighters[1].stages.atk=1;if(mode==='protected')timer(s,1,'强化保护');if(mode==='immune')s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,null);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],mode==='success');assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),mode==='success'?0:3000);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,mode==='protected'?1:0);}});

success.assertion: test('4885/1240回合末未击败才授下次技能，灰鳞变后按下次实际最大HP算2966，攻击或属性均附粉且能力等级不改基数',()=>{for(const [next,stage]of[[10086,0],[20231,6],[20231,-6]]){const s=make({move:38314,index:2,soul:true,loadout:[38314,10086,20231,38315,38316]});turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,8900);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.next12404885.denominator,3);s.fighters[0].stages.atk=stage;turn(s,next);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),2966);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.next12404885,undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.applied12404885[0].maxHp,8900);}for(const hp of[1,1000]){const s=make({move:38314,index:2,soul:true,targetHp:hp});turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.next12404885,undefined);}});

success.name: 4885/817同一已核实模板版本仅次回合红易伤翻倍，不翻固定百分比真实；450随机回复150/300端点与技能禁疗
success.assertion: test('4885/817同一已核实模板版本仅次回合红易伤翻倍，不翻固定百分比真实；450随机回复150/300端点与技能禁疗',()=>{const loadout=[29297,10086,29298,38315,38316],a=make({...row(817),loadout}),b=make({...row(817),index:-1,loadout});turn(a,29297,10127);turn(b,29297,10127);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)for(const type of['fixed','percent','true']){const hp=c.t.hp;c.hurt(c.t,100,'817非红不翻倍',type);assert.equal(hp-c.t.hp,100);}},()=>turn(a,10086));turn(b,10086);assert.ok(sum(a)>=Math.floor(sum(b)*2));assert.ok(sum(a)<Math.ceil((sum(b)+1)*2));for(const [rng,want]of[[0,1150],[1-Number.EPSILON,1300]]){const s=make({...row(450),hp:1000}),engine=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...engine,run(p,ops,c){if(p==='afterHit'&&ops.some(x=>x.effectId===450))return engine.run(p,ops,{...c,random:()=>rng});return engine.run(p,ops,c);}};try{turn(s);}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=engine;}assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,want);}const ban=make({...row(450),hp:1000});timer(ban,0,'技能禁疗');turn(ban);assert.equal(ban.fighters[0].hp,1000);});

success.assertion: test('4885/797清回合成功技能禁疗不封血药，1355暴击含零红才给次数免异；1214异常目标固定吸取300理论回复，67下一只明确延期不改当前上限',()=>{for(const protect of[false,true]){const s=make(row(797));if(protect)timer(s,1,'protect');turn(s);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].effects['技能禁疗'],!protect);}for(const mode of['crit','zero','normal']){const s=make(row(1355));if(mode!=='normal')timer(s,0,'必定暴击');if(mode==='zero')timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune??0,mode==='normal'?0:1);}for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make({...row(1214),hp:1000});s.fighters[1].ailments['中毒']=3;if(immune)timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');turn(s);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),immune?0:300);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1300);}const future=make({...row(67),targetHp:1});turn(future);assert.equal(future.fighters[1].stats.maxHp,9000);assert.equal(future.fighters[1].hp,0);});
